command:
set -e; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; adb -s "$SERIAL" logcat -c; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am force-stop pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge || true; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am start -n pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge/.MainActivity --ez run_shizuku_probe true >/dev/null; sleep 8; echo '=== probe result ==='; OUT=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" logcat -d -v brief | grep -E 'AiCallBridge: (shizuku_probe_result:|probe=|error=|mode=|binder_ping=|shizuku_uid=|service_uid=|service_pid=|prepared_|active_|heartbeat_|privileged_uid=|offcall_parity_ok=)' | tail -n 80 || true); printf '%s
' "$OUT"; printf '%s' "$OUT" | grep -q 'error='; echo phase2c_root_cause_message_captured=true
